league_run_note: Second room of the League run (Sidney E0493 belongs to another block). Played with party v1 (Flutter Mane/Iron Bundle/Chi-Yu/Urshifu-SS/Rillaboom/Incineroar). After Glacia a1 the party was rebuilt to v2 (see 326); Phoebe was not replayed with v2 - v2 swaps in Kingambit and Xerneas, both better into Ghosts than what they replace, so this result is if anything an upper bound on Phoebe's difficulty. Real-run carry after this room: Flutter Mane, Iron Bundle, Chi-Yu, Urshifu fainted (Revives, field medicine); Incineroar 106/378 (Full Restore); Urshifu Wicked Blow 1/8 PP left - PP is the binding carry cost.

attempts.notes: Lunala Moongeist Beam OHKO'd Flutter Mane T1 and Iron Bundle T2 (Bundle was Icy-Winded to -1 Speed and no longer at full HP, so no Sash). Marshadow CC on Incineroar for 272, Marshadow then OHKO'd by Wicked Blow. Giratina Protect twice with real payoffs. Gengar Sludge Bomb + Spectrier Shadow Ball KO'd Chi-Yu on a switch-in; Urshifu Wicked Blow crit swept Lunala/Marshadow/Banette/Gengar/Spectrier. Urshifu fell to Specs Shadow Ball (resisted) + Life Orb on the last turn.

attempts.notes: Replay ordered by the coordinator after the build-10 Mega fix. T1 my Mega Evolution cost Kangaskhan its Scrappy so Fake Out failed on Lunala and Moongeist Beam + Icy Wind KO'd Whimsicott; the AI switched Lunala out into Kowtow Cleave (Marshadow ate it, then died to Sucker Punch) and switched Giratina out for Gengar into a second Kowtow Cleave - Gengar (the slot-6 Mega) fainted on entry without ever getting a turn to Mega Evolve; Giratina's Will-O-Wisp burned both Kingambit and Kangaskhan; Lunala Protected three times (T2, T5, T9) and used Wide Guard once; Knock Off removed Covert Cloak, Leftovers and Choice Specs in turn; Banette Mega Evolved on its first action (T11) and Protected twice before Draco Meteor + Knock Off ended it. Won 6-2.

ai_defects.description: Second authored Mega never fires. Phoebe's mega_slots 4,6: Banette Mega Evolved; Gengar (slot 6) entered T6 with usable_gimmick=mega and mega_already_used=true, chose Sludge Bomb and was KO'd as base Gengar. EmeraldChampions_GetMegaEvolutionLimit returns 2 for the Elite Four (src/emerald_champions_battle_plan.c:54) and CanBattlerMegaEvolve honours it (src/battle_util.c:8536-8555), but the AI gimmick gate in src/battle_controllers.c:3304 uses HasTrainerUsedGimmick(), which reads gBattleStruct->gimmick.activated[battler] - and SetGimmickAsActivated (src/battle_gimmick.c:120-126) marks the same-trainer partner POSITION as activated when the first Mega fires, so whatever later occupies that position is treated as already used. Same symptom on Glacia (Baxcalibur, see 326). BUILD-10 UPDATE: the gate is fixed - Banette evolved on its first action in a2. Gengar still never evolved because the AI switched it into a super-effective attack (defect 3).
T6 Giratina used Poltergeist on Incineroar whose Sitrus Berry had already been eaten (item shown as none since T4); the move failed. Better: Icy Wind or Poltergeist on Urshifu (Life Orb).

a2 T3/T4 (build-10): the AI hard-switched Lunala out into Kowtow Cleave (Marshadow took 229 and died next turn) and then Giratina out for Gengar into a second Kowtow Cleave; Gengar, the Mega ace, fainted on entry. Same switch-into-super-effective family as 327/328/329.

calibration: Build-8: won 6-4. Build-10 replay with the final League party: won 6-2 with both Megas now able to fire (Banette did; Gengar was thrown away by a switch). Keep all offsets.
cooler: The room already has a clear identity. It would be cooler if the Gengar Mega actually fired (defect 1) - as played the trap never existed and the room was carried by Lunala's Moongeist Beam and Kyurem-style raw damage. Suggest Encore be authored to prefer a non-Dark target, and Giratina's Poltergeist to check the target's item.
legality: No legality problem found in the authored set.
step_up: A step above Sidney? Cannot compare directly. On build-10 with the final League party Phoebe cost two Pokemon; it is the gentlest of the four rooms I played, and its danger is concentrated in Lunala's Moongeist Beam and Giratina's burns.
